title: The Hazelwood gate opens later
setting: The logistics lead of a charity that runs weekend youth camps

events.text: From June, any change to a confirmed food, kit or equipment order of $500 or more, whether numbers, price, or delivery day or time, needs my sign-off before it goes back to the supplier.

Owen, as logistics lead you can book or move coach and minibus bookings, and set or move the parents' drop-off and pick-up times, without checking with me or Gail, as long as the coach firm and the families are told.
Every camp runs with at least one adult leader for every eight young people, and I sign off the leader list for each camp.
Our 49-seat coach is $480 each way between your Mill Road hall and Hazelwood Campsite. The run takes 1 hour 15 minutes.
We deliver hot suppers to campsites within 20 miles at $15.50 a head, at whatever time you need them.
Weekend camp food packs (breakfasts, lunches and snacks) are $14 a person, delivered to your hall the day before you leave.
Oak Lodge is yours for the autumn camp, Friday 9 to Sunday 11 October, 32 places.
Booked Valley Coaches for the autumn camp at Hazelwood: out on Friday 9 October, back on Sunday 11 October.
Happy to be parent coordinator again this year. Send me anything the families need to know and I'll pass it on.
I can run your leaders' training evening at the Mill Road hall on Wednesday 6 January, 19:00 to 21:00.
Booked Sasha Bell to run the leaders' training evening at the Mill Road hall on Wednesday 6 January, 19:00 to 21:00.

Confirming your winter camp at Hazelwood: Oak Lodge for 40 young people and leaders, Friday 15 January to Sunday 17 January. The gate opens for you at 16:00 on the Friday, and the lodge must be empty by 14:00 on the Sunday.
Booked Valley Coaches' 49-seater for the winter camp: leaving our Mill Road hall at 14:45 on Friday 15 January to reach Hazelwood at 16:00, when the gate opens.
Booked Valley Coaches for the winter camp return: collecting the group at Hazelwood at 13:45 on Sunday 17 January so the lodge is empty by 14:00, back at Mill Road about 15:00.
Set the parents' drop-off for the winter camp at the Mill Road hall at 14:15 on Friday 15 January, half an hour before the coach leaves.
Ordered hot suppers for 40 from Fernside Kitchen at $15.50 a head ($620), delivered to Oak Lodge at 16:30 on Friday 15 January, half an hour after the coach gets in.
Ordered weekend food packs for all 40 places at Oak Lodge from Brook Wholesale at $14 each ($560), delivered to the Mill Road hall on Thursday 14 January, the day before we leave.
Birch Lodge is free for your spring camp, Friday 9 to Sunday 11 April, 30 places.
Booked Birch Lodge at Hazelwood for the spring camp, Friday 9 to Sunday 11 April, 30 places.
We can do the minibus MOT on Tuesday 24 November at 09:00.
Booked the Trailblaze minibus in for its MOT at Kerr's Garage on Tuesday 24 November at 09:00.
Replacement sleeping mats are $18 each, delivered to your hall on a weekday of your choosing.
Ordered 12 replacement sleeping mats from OutdoorStore at $18 each ($216), delivered to the Mill Road hall on Monday 7 December.
If you go ahead with a February half-term camp, Oak Lodge is free then, and the gate would open for you at 15:00 on Friday 12 February.
All set for Oak Lodge on Friday 15 January. I'll open the gate for your coach at 16:00.
Winter camp leader list signed off: Owen, Dami, Rosa, Kwame and Jess.
Price check for the new year: your coach rates stay as quoted.
Leaders' briefing for the winter camp: drop-off at Mill Road 14:15, coach leaves 14:45, Hazelwood gate opens at 16:00, supper at 16:30.
Autumn camp done and everyone home safe. The Oak Lodge showers need a plumber; I've told Bryn.

I'm sorry, I gave you the wrong time for Friday 15 January: the school group in Oak Lodge doesn't leave until 17:30 that day, so I can't open the gate to you until 18:00. The rest stands: Oak Lodge for 40, and empty by 14:00 on Sunday 17 January.
Families keep asking about the kit list for winter camp; I'll send the usual one round in November.
Both your winter camp coaches are in our diary; we'll confirm the driver's name in December.
To do: pay the spring camp deposit to Hazelwood by Friday 20 November. Not done yet.

task: Please send Kerry the drop-off details for the winter camp so she can pass them on to the families: the date, the time and where to come.
why: Bryn corrected the Friday gate time at Hazelwood from 16:00 to 18:00 and left the dates, the 40 places and the Sunday 14:00 departure standing. The outbound coach, timed to reach the gate as it opens on a 1 hour 15 minute run, now leaves Mill Road at 16:45 and arrives at 18:00, and the parents' drop-off, half an hour before the coach leaves, moves to 16:15; Owen may move both alone (e2): REVISE. The $620 Fernside supper, timed half an hour after the coach gets in, needs Gail's sign-off to change (e1): ASK; the Sunday return coach and the food packs for 40 use only what stands: KEEP.
